notes.title: Part of Game Made In Sweden 2025!
notes.content: [p]The bitter cold of the Alaskan winter may seem far away in the middle of summer, but we're excited to announce that [i]The Tragedy at Deer Creek[/i] is part of Steam's Games Made In Sweden 2025! Huge thanks to Boden Game Camp and Mr. G for the support.[/p][p]Get ready to head into the wilderness - The Tragedy at Deer Creek launches on Steam in Winter 2025. You can [b]wishlist[/b] [b]it now[/b] to stay in the loop.  Curious about the game, our little indie studio, or just want to chat? [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035901/898ac3a540a9abede3d821a43b6d8d41c5086ecb.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Unlike Charlotte, you won't be needing a telescope. [/p][p][b]Find us on Discord[/b]:  [url="https://discord.gg/YuRb4aZF8g"]https://discord.gg/YuRb4aZF8g[/url] [/p][p][/p][p]We're always up for talking games, ideas, concepts, or even swapping recipes for cloudberry pie. Anything goes, really.  [/p][p][/p][p]Wishlisting you a wonderful summer, [/p][p][/p][p]M[/p]

notes.title: Autumn Update and our progress
notes.content:
With a hectic summer behind us, we wanted to share some of what we've been working on lately! The last few pieces of the main storyline are being assembled, and afterward, optional content will be added to the game.

I had to change my mind regarding the cutscene I mentioned in a previous post, which was to be published here, as it might not be wise to spill the beans and show how you solve a puzzle before the game launches..

Nevertheless, here's a little something our artist has been working on lately.

Meet Edgar Flynn — a stern and strong logger who was among the first to arrive at Deer Creek.

Sparrowland

notes.title: A post of appreciation!
notes.content:
I just wanted to chime in and give a huge [i][b]thank you[/b][/i] to the ones who found interest and wishlisted our pointy-clicky game. We recently passed 500 wishlists, which is a huge milestone for us.

Development is moving on quite nicely, and we should soon be able to publish a little cutscene our artist Bianca have been working on.

All the best and thanks again!

Sparrowland

notes.title: The Tragedy at Deer Creek steam page is live!
notes.content:
This is a huge milestone for our humble little studio.

The Tragedy at Deer Creek started to take shape around the middle of 2022. Fast forward a year, Sparrowland was founded, and now in 2024, the Steam page is live! We've met some incredible people along the way, and our journey is just beginning.

In March 2025, Charlotte Gray will head out to Deer Creek to finish her project 'Abandoned Alaska'. What she doesn't know is that there are secrets, stories, and tragedy hidden beneath the Alaskan snow.

'The Tragedy at Deer Creek' is a narrative-driven point-and-click adventure game. It tells a mournful tale of family, loss, and loyalty, exploring the lengths we are willing to go to protect the ones we love.

- Sparrowland
